arguments.label: Overall checkpoint
arguments.text: Partial answer. Covered cases R001 through R016 in ascending order, each read from its claim and receipt. Not covered: R017 through R048; no account is recorded for them, and no conclusion is drawn for them. Pattern in covered cases: R001 and R007 and R013 show full matched receipt with recorded acknowledgment (stated, not independently shown); R002, R008, R014 match but record no acknowledgment; R003, R009, R015 carry an "-earlier" tag suffix; R004, R010, R016 have byte counts that differ from the expected value; R005 and R011 have an unrecorded destination; R006 and R012 bear other case IDs (R054, R060). All findings rest on copied receipt values, and no underlying desk records are in the packets.
